newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay blue chips lead rally, index up 1.31 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bombay blue chips lead rally, index up 1.31 pct.

text.p: The bull party in Bombay stocks continued on Wednesday with blue chips surging higher, driven by foreign fund buying in front-line stocks and local buyers jumping onto the band-wagon, traders said.
"This seems to be more of a speculator-driven rally despite some fund buying seen in select stocks, said Sanjay Vaid, chief dealer at Lloyds Securities.
Bombay's index soared to a 32-month high at 4,357.22, beating 4,310.52 points reached on October 21, 1994.
By 1315 hours (0745 GMT), the index was up 61.49 points, or 1.43 percent, at 4,362.35 over Tuesday's close.
